ctaHeading: Truganina's cabinet makers are ready — let's craft your project.
aboutText: Founded in Truganina, Endorsed Group is dedicated to becoming the leading cabinetry partner for housing and construction projects in Melbourne and beyond. Our commitment to quality, consistency, and reliability ensures that every piece we produce meets the highest standards. With a focus on professionalism, we collaborate closely with clients to bring their visions to life.
servicesText: We offer a complete range of cabinetry services, from custom designs to professional installations for residential and commercial projects. Based in Truganina, our team ensures each piece is crafted with precision and durability in mind, meeting the demands of modern construction.

services.title: Kitchen Cabinetry
services.desc: Custom kitchen cabinets designed and built in Truganina, tailored to your space and style for new builds and renovations.

services.title: Bathroom Vanities
services.desc: Functional and stylish vanities crafted with quality materials, perfect for modern bathrooms in Melbourne homes.

services.title: Custom Joinery
services.desc: Bespoke joinery solutions for unique spaces, including shelving, wardrobes, and storage units manufactured in-house.

services.title: Commercial Fit-outs
services.desc: Cabinetry for offices, retail, and hospitality projects, delivered with efficiency and attention to detail.

services.title: Storage Solutions
services.desc: Maximise space with our custom storage options, from pantry units to laundry cabinetry for residential projects.

services.title: Installation Services
services.desc: Professional installation by our experienced team, ensuring perfect fit and finish for all cabinetry projects.
